bio.text: Theresa Hatathlie is a Democratic member of the Arizona State Senate representing District 6; she assumed office on January 9, 2023, and her current term ends on January 11, 2027.
She earned bachelor's degrees in business administration and management and in human resources management and services from Northern Arizona University in 2004 and 2005.

Her career experience includes work as logistics coordinator and legislative liaison for the Yee Ha'ólníi Doo Navajo and Hopi Families COVID-19 Relief Fund and as human resources director of Tuba City Unified School District 15.
Ballotpedia reports that she is not running for re-election in 2026.
